senses.gloss:
लौकायतिक m. (-कः) An atheist, a materialist, a Bauddha.
 E. लोकायत
a particular heterodox doctrine, and ठक् aff.; also लोकायतिक ।

लौकिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Mundane, worldly, human, what prevails
amongst or is familiar to mankind.
 f. (-की)
 1. Common, vulgar.
2. Secular, temporal.
 3. Customary.
 n. (-यं) Any usage or general
custom.
 E. लोक mankind, the world, and ठण् aff.

लौकिकता f. (-ता)
 1. Worldliness.
 2. Worldly currency custom. E.
तल् added to the last; also लौकिकत्वं ।

लौक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं)
 1. Mundane, human.
 2. Common.
 E. लोक and घञ् aff.
